definition: חָקָה verb only Pu`al cut in, carve (Late Hebrew represent, imitate ; || חקק ) — Pu`al Participle מְחֻקֶּה 1Kgs 6:35 ; Ezek 8:10 + Ezek 23:14 ( Co מְחֻקִּים , after ᵐ5 ᵑ6 ᵑ7 ᵑ9 ), carved figure on wall Ezek 8:10 ; Ezek 23:14 (where read אנשׁים מחקים , see above) = substantive carved work 1Kgs 6:35 (on doors of temple). Hithpa`el Imperfect 2 masculine singular עלשָֿׁרְשֵׁי רַגְלַי תִּתְחַקֶּה Job 13:27 thou gravest thee a graving (= markest a line) for (i.e. about) the soles of my feet , fixest limits for them (see Di ). חֻקָּה see below חקק . below
